WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE_PART('year', CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE)) - DATE_PART('year', CAST(REPLACE(o.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) - CASE

             AND DATE_PART('day', CAST(REPLACE(o.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) > 14)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
